patch_description: This version uses a feasibility-search approach rather than directly assigning each model greedily. It first builds a valid upper-bound placement, then binary-searches the best possible maximum KVPR. For each candidate KVPR threshold, a branch-and-bound solver checks whether all models can be placed while satisfying both GPU memory limits and the target KVPR bound. This directly optimizes the minimax objective and uses symmetry elimination plus hard-to-place ordering for efficient search.
